# A rock (generated by make_env.py).
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name Rock --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --location 0 0 0.25
scale 1.3 1.0 0.7
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.08 --seed 5
mode object
material new Stone --base-color 0.682 0.416 0.278 --no-slot
material assign Stone
select all
shade flat
export rock.glb
